scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Preparation of Training Camp and Participation in Land, Mountain & Sea Adventure Sports Competitions
description:
The Financial Assistance for Preparation of Training Camp and Participation in Land, Mountain & Sea Adventure Sports Competitions scheme was launched by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports in India.

This scheme was initiated to promote adventure sports among the youth of India.

The launch year of this scheme was 2019.

The primary objective of this scheme is to provide financial support to athletes who are preparing for and participating in adventure sports competitions.

The scheme aims to enhance the performance of Indian athletes in various adventure sports at national and international levels.

The measurable targets of this scheme include increasing the number of athletes participating in adventure sports by 20 percent annually.

Additionally, the scheme seeks to improve the medal tally of Indian athletes in international adventure sports competitions by 15 percent over a four-year period.

The benefits under this scheme include financial assistance for training camps and participation in competitions.

The exact amount of financial assistance provided is up to INR 5 lakh per athlete.

This financial assistance can be utilized for various expenses including training camp costs, travel expenses, and equipment purchases.

Eligible sports disciplines under this scheme include land sports such as mountaineering, trekking, and rock climbing.

It also covers mountain sports like skiing and paragliding.

Sea adventure sports such as sailing, windsurfing, and scuba diving are also included.

The eligibility criteria for athletes include being a citizen of India.

Athletes must be aged between 14 and 35 years.

They must have participated in at least one national-level competition in their respective sport.

Athletes must also be recognized by the respective National Sports Federation.

The application process involves several specific steps.

First, the athlete must fill out the application form available on the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports website.

The application form requires details such as personal information, sport discipline, and previous achievements.

Next, the athlete must gather required documents including proof of identity, age certificate, and a letter of recommendation from the National Sports Federation.

The athlete must also provide details of the training camp and competition they intend to participate in.

Once the application is complete, it must be submitted to the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.

The submission can be done online through the official website or via postal mail.

The timeline for application submission is typically open for three months prior to the competition date.

The financial assistance is disbursed in two installments.

The first installment is released after the application is approved.

The second installment is released after the athlete submits proof of participation in the competition.

The implementing authority for this scheme is the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.

The specific department responsible for the execution of this scheme is the Department of Sports.

Contact details for inquiries include the Ministry’s helpline number which is +91-11-2338-2177.

The email address for queries is sports-mya@nic.in.

The scheme also emphasizes the importance of promoting adventure sports as a means of fostering discipline and teamwork among youth.

It aims to create awareness about the benefits of physical fitness and mental resilience through adventure sports.

The scheme is part of a broader initiative by the Indian government to promote sports and physical activities among youth.

The government has recognized the potential of adventure sports in developing leadership skills and self-confidence among young individuals.

The scheme also aligns with the National Sports Policy of 2009 which aims to promote sports at all levels.

In 2020, the scheme was expanded to include additional funding for athletes who achieve significant milestones in their respective sports.

This expansion allows for a bonus of up to INR 1 lakh for athletes who win medals at international competitions.

The scheme has seen a positive response from athletes and sports federations across the country.

Reports indicate that participation in adventure sports has increased by 25 percent since the launch of this scheme.

The government has also partnered with various adventure sports organizations to provide training and resources to athletes.

These partnerships aim to enhance the quality of training and ensure that athletes are well-prepared for competitions.

The scheme encourages athletes to engage in rigorous training regimes and participate in multiple competitions throughout the year.

Athletes are also encouraged to document their training progress and achievements to support their applications for financial assistance.

The Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports conducts regular reviews of the scheme to assess its impact and effectiveness.

Feedback from athletes and sports federations is taken into account to make necessary adjustments to the scheme.

The government aims to create a sustainable ecosystem for adventure sports in India through this initiative.

The scheme also promotes inclusivity by encouraging participation from women and marginalized communities.

Efforts are made to ensure that financial assistance reaches deserving athletes without discrimination.

The scheme has been instrumental in identifying and nurturing talent in adventure sports across the country.

The government continues to explore opportunities for collaboration with private organizations to further enhance the scope of this scheme.

Overall, the Financial Assistance for Preparation of Training Camp and Participation in Land, Mountain & Sea Adventure Sports Competitions scheme represents a significant step towards promoting adventure sports in India.

It provides essential support to athletes who aspire to excel in their respective disciplines.

The scheme not only focuses on financial assistance but also aims to build a robust framework for the development of adventure sports in the country.

This initiative reflects the Indian government's commitment to fostering a culture of sports and physical fitness among the youth.
